notes.title: The Looter Dev Update #4: New enemies, tweaks, and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re coming to you with another Dev Update. This one will be quick and short, but we still wanted to check-in, as it has become our monthly tradition. 

First of all, check out some then and now comparisons of how our game changed during the development. At a first glance, those look like two different games!

[previewyoutube=b7-EgrM6p9k;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/f1b17617a3b8697d57b2bca16f17dbb5f6f881a9.gif[/img]

You can also see a significant portion of the game in action in this recording from a live development stream, in which the Tactical Dogs team took everyone behind the scenes of our action-adventure platformer.

[previewyoutube=0G_I-PP0dZo;full][/previewyoutube]

As for some new content, take a look at some of the new enemies coming in the newest location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/191b11483570888a47b71cf5914a8c55d073b5d7.png[/img]

It’s rude not to make introductions, so from the left, meet Walker, Exploder, Carrier, Ram, and Teleporter. Teleporter might be called different in the near future, as we’re still debating if he’ll be able to teleport. 

As we’re on the topic of new enemies, here’s a little sneak peek at a location we’ve started doing assets for. It’s daaaaark… and even more dank!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/5f6fe18a0196fb913207eee46fb04e1ad96dff17.png[/img]

That would be it for today. Please follow and wishlist The Looter, and spread the word. Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]official Discord[/url] to share your feedback and thoughts about our game!

See you next time!

notes.title: The Looter Dev Update #3 with some new faces
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s a brand new year, so it’s time for a dev update about [b]The Looter[/b].

We’ve spent last month mainly polishing and testing things we had ready before, so this update will be a tad shorter. Still, we want to show you some new cool things we’ve been working on.

First up, new location - [b]The Church[/b]. A sanctuary hidden within the deadly lands. It’s a massive building that we hope will be to your liking. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/8bf03424cdadfe665918424014a70c1a901a8c52.png[/img]

With the new location come [b]new NPCs[/b]. Two of them will play a major role in your adventures. Can you guess which ones?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/ec64946a0c7c9c1207ebdf8b52343a9d2fe2250b.png[/img]

We’ve also tinkered with a [b]new finisher animation[/b]. Turns out that an axe is a perfect replacement for a katana. A true samurai-esque addition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/f09942a7a7bad13287a8e266e16f03ec13be2446.gif[/img]

Another thing we’d like to show you is a very [b]short cutscene[/b] that we’re planning to add during a boss fight. It's not much but we think it adds some nice touch and improves worldbuilding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/e7375235648506b7f11a6edaea5611e22f4710d1.gif[/img]

Let us know what you think on the Steam forum and feel invited to [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]join us on Discord[/url].

See you next time!

notes.title: The Looter Dev Update #2 - Under the desert sun
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The last couple of weeks we’ve spent mostly on designing and building the desert, another big location you’ll explore in [b]The Looter[/b].

We want this setting to look unique and pose [b]new challenges to the players[/b]. We now have the whole geometry of this location ready and started filling it with gameplay. Your main task at this stage of The Looter will be to repair a motorcycle in order to get to the Monastery. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/6f57ea609b61459856a47a44470274ab49a10e00.png[/img]

Let’s have a closer look at the new enemies you’ll meet in the desert. 

Starting with this dried-up, [b]mummified corpses[/b] that (for now) we call “Dry Arms”. They’ll be pretty challenging and often require you to dodge to avoid their attacks. The only way to deal them damage will be to find and attack their vital points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/e67c64cccc27bcce0b8e975118c502c9f09f39e8.png[/img]

We’re also designing Raiders, [b]desert outlaws[/b] with various weapons and combat styles. Ranged one will throw knives at you, while the fighter will press you with melee attacks using a huge machete. Each encounter will require you to adapt your tactics to overcome them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/4a52c1550a94add401eccfccdb3d7a564af0cc77.gif[/img]

Finally, we have a fresh peek at the boss from our trailer that you’ll fight in the desert. An [b]armored Raider truck[/b] will chase you on your way to the Monastery and deal damage with powerful attacks, including rockets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/269cbd5ebd6cebf5ddc516d9ad43bff9b6ed3754.gif[/img]

Right now we’ve started working on a playable demo of the game. It will include a number of locations, enemies, and gameplay mechanics to try. We plan to share it with you early next year. Follow [b]The Looter[/b] here on Steam, so you don’t miss it!

That’s all for this [b]Dev Update[/b]. Let us know what you think about the game and we hope to see you on our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]official Discord[/url].

See you next time!

notes.title: The Looter Dev Update #1 - Big Bad Wolf and new guns
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to our first (of many, we hope) Dev Update on [b]The Looter[/b]. We’ve been working hard on the down-low for quite a while now, so today we want to show you some of the new features, enemies, and locations. 

Let’s start with brand new items and weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/3f54f547ee2f147dab15d0ffea3f197d6229c2b5.gif[/img]

The Looter is full of large chasms and obstacles that block your way. In order to reach the highest platforms and cross dangerous ravines, you’re gonna need something special, and we’ve got you covered. [b]The Grappler[/b] will allow you to access new areas, previously impossible to reach. It’s a true Batman-esque addition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/0ba915a829e4bfacba32bdc0ef8f7eb22be0734c.gif[/img]

Our hero's arsenal is constantly growing. A [b]shotgun[/b] is a brand new weapon. It shoots 5 pellets that can pierce opponents and crates but has a limited range and long reload time. You’ll need to approach the enemies with caution, or you might find yourself in quite a bit of trouble.

The Grappler and Shotgun will come in handy during your adventures. Especially because of the fact that new enemies are coming to The Looter. Today we want to show you a brand new monster. It's current codename is [b]Nupagadi[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/daf50a11f59eabc2b76503b8e2ebb3ba52e24cc1.gif[/img]

You might call this one a true alpha as it’s basically [b]a wolf on turbo steroids[/b] - it's faster, stronger, much sturdier, and certainly more ravenous than other of its kind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/29fb86dbe187ffd41082fc9b366c3b38f8bcede3.gif[/img]

Nupagadi is not the only new enemy that we’ve added to the game. The home of all insects and dragonflies - [b]The Hive[/b] is the boss of the Towers level. To destroy the Hive you need to kill the constantly spawning dragonflies and levitating orbs, and then exploit its weaknesses. Looks grotesque, doesn’t it? Yuck!

Now, let’s take a look at some of the areas coming to The Looter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/1d00e43e160055c017d8c613e4203258c29b3b7b.png[/img]

First up, the [b]Forest Settlement[/b].
 
Over the last few months, we’ve been working on the last stages of Tortura. Unlike previous areas, this one is much darker and more dangerous. It will be the final test of your skills before leaving the forest and heading out into the unknown.

And the unknown will now become a little bit more known…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36010648/ea5ab8805c71cdc764f83068338c5c6b9568a988.png[/img]

After a long journey through the woods, we’re finally leaving this dark and dangerous pile of trees to enter an even more dangerous [b]Desert[/b]. This location will be much different than the forest which was full of life, trees, and bushes. In the coming months, we’ll be focusing on building this new sandy landscape.

That’s all for this Dev Update. Let us know what you think about new features on the Steam forum, or our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Retrovibe Discord[/url].

Remember to follow The Looter here on Steam, wishlist the game and tell your friends.

See you next time!
